facts.fact: Expresso das Ilhas, reporting a government communiqué of 17 December 2025, states that until then the declaration of the national social registry (CSU) was issued and printed at the municipal councils (Câmaras Municipais), a step no longer needed now that benefit-managing bodies query the registry directly; it gives no count of councils and does not say how they were connected.
facts.system: Cadastro Social Único (CSU) declarations issued at the Câmaras Municipais

systems.tiers: Declarations issued and printed at the Câmaras Municipais until December 2025; from then queried directly by the bodies that manage social benefits through a data consultation application

note: The one fact rests on the article's statement that CSU declarations were issued and printed at municipal councils; the article does not use the word online and names no connection, so the parent should weigh whether it meets the working-online test.
